items.title: Awesome Quant
items.content_text:
### Trading & Backtesting

*   [capitalcom-cli (⭐1)](https://github.com/SimonTarara62/capitalcom-cli) - `Python` - Unofficial CLI and async SDK for the Capital.com broker API: market data, guarded order execution, and real-time streaming.

### Market Data & Data Sources

*   [disclosure-alpha (⭐1)](https://github.com/alwank/disclosure-alpha) - `Python` - Deterministic SEC filing analytics for 10-K/10-Q: section extraction, tone and boilerplate metrics, year-over-year diff, and reproducible disclosure risk scores. CLI, Python SDK, HTTP panel screener, and MCP — no LLM required.

### Commercial & Proprietary Services

*   [FinSignals](https://finsignals.ai) - `Python` - Reddit-tuned NLP API classifying financial posts across 7 dimensions: sentiment, directionality, quality, post type, relevance score, author confidence, and sarcasm. Free tier available.
*   [The Stall](https://the-stall.intuitek.ai) - `JavaScript` - 277 pay-per-call tools via MCP: US stocks, crypto, DeFi analytics, Polymarket prediction markets, macro data, and sanctions screening. USDC on Base. No API key required. [GitHub (⭐2)](https://github.com/thebrierfox/the-stall)
